title: Reproducibility package for "Global fold and cusp geometry of an asymmetric two-gene cross-repressive module"
description: Symbolic and arbitrary-precision verification scripts and figure-generating code for the manuscript Global fold and cusp geometry of an asymmetric two-gene cross-repressive module (submitted to SIAM Journal on Applied Dynamical Systems). Each script recomputes one group of statements of the paper: the exact singular set and the vanishing of det J on it, the sign identity of the tangency condition, the sum-of-squares identity and the bound behind uniqueness of the cusp, the slope identity behind the absence of self-intersections of the discriminant, the equilibrium counts across the discriminant, the closed-form center-manifold coefficients, and the analytic expansion of the fold about the cusp. Computations use 30 to 50 significant digits; double precision is insufficient near the cusp because of cancellation in the symmetry-breaking parameter.
